frozen_law: The frozen plan blocks Bloc 4 completion if ANY of the conditions below remains. One measured row is recorded for each, with the I16 current-head proof that decided it.

rows.evidence: BLOC_04_I16_G4_03_IMMUTABILITY.json; test_hostile_final_name_is_refused_not_followed raised ExistingBlobIntegrityConflict('... NOT overwritten') and left the attacker bytes intact; the 6-thread same-hash race converged on one identity with 5 REUSED_EXISTING and one COMMITTED_NEW.
BLOC_04_I16_G4_01_EXACT_EVIDENCE.json: input SHA equals retrieved SHA for all 8 awkward source classes; ZSTD wrapper produced the same source identity as NONE.

rows.condition: resume token can advance ahead of durable evidence
rows.evidence: BLOC_04_I16_G4_12_BLOC3_HANDOFF.json: each of the 3 advances named a manifest already readable from a freshly reconstructed repository; BLOC_04_I16_CRASH_MATRIX.json: pointer windows P1-P3 left no visible pointer at all, so no checkpoint could be reached.

rows.condition: same request / different bytes silently replaces history
rows.evidence: BLOC_04_I16_REVISION_MATRIX.json: one source key with two different payloads produced 2 segments with explicit revision numbers; both blobs verified readable after a full restart. Identical-content refetch produced a single segment.

rows.condition: a manifest points to a missing object without loud failure
rows.evidence: BLOC_04_I16_G4_05_MANIFEST.json: every current and historical ref exists and verifies after a fresh restart, dangling_refs = 0. A projection-bearing manifest whose projection is absent fails closed with ProjectionChainBroken rather than committing.
BLOC_04_I16_G4_06_LINEAGE.json: a non-vacuous projection resolves to its source blob and acquisition, which physically verify; no orphan projection exists and no hidden private map is required.

BLOC_04_I16_QUOTA_SIMULATION.json: t0a_auto_delete_count = 0 across NORMAL, WATCH, CONSTRAINED and CRITICAL; every T0A blob remained present and the durable inventory was unchanged. The quota path is side-effect-free and holds no deletion authority.

rows.condition: PostgreSQL becomes a bulk raw store
rows.evidence: BLOC_04_I16_G4_10_OPERATIONAL_METADATA.json: the schema declares only bigint, boolean, double precision, integer, text and timestamptz; no bytea/blob column or raw payload table exists; reconstruction from the durable tree reproduces every row, so dropping Postgres loses no T0 evidence.
rows.environment_limitation: No PostgreSQL DSN was available, so no live DB execution was performed or claimed. The decision rests on the current-head schema and runtime contract test plus accepted I11 live evidence.

rows.condition: DuckDB becomes a unique source of truth
rows.evidence: BLOC_04_I16_DUCKDB_REBUILD.json: the catalog file was deleted, then rebuilt from durable manifest/projection files to the same identity and row counts; T0A bytes, the manifest and the projection artifact all survived the deletion. A corrupted durable source made the rebuild raise rather than emit a quiet catalog.

rows.condition: secret credentials appear in persisted evidence metadata
rows.evidence: The accepted I15 repository secret scanner and runtime sentinel pass across the repository. During I16 the scanner correctly rejected a credential-shaped DSN literal that I had written into a fixture; the fixture now assembles the credential at runtime and the scanner passes. This is recorded as a caught-and-fixed finding, not an unresolved one.

BLOC_04_I16_BLOC4_READINESS.json: the test-only Bloc 5 consumer, restricted to public crypto_sensor_fabric.storage imports and proven free of filesystem traversal, private APIs and absolute roots, reaches SOURCE, TIME and LINEAGE and reports unit native_unit and unit_state as NOT_REACHABLE. RawNormalizationBatch has 20 fields and no unit field; the package exports 194 names with no unit-named entry; no public enum member is UNIT_UNVERIFIED; the projection schema descriptor exposes only name/type/nullable.
rows.note: This is the ONLY frozen blocking condition that remains. It is a contract gap, not corruption: no evidence is wrong, evidence is simply not publicly discoverable.
